In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reaction of liquid sulfur dioxide with Δ5,6,7,10(19) vitamin D3 and its derivatives is a useful synthetic tool to give 1,2-unsaturated Δ5-3-ketosteroids.
the reaction of vitamin D with sulfur dioxide is not a good model for the mechanism of the photochemical reaction of vitamin D in skin.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Δ5,6-double bond is not the most reactive part of vitamin D2 and D3.
the Δ5,6-double bond is more reactive to the addition of SO2 than the Δ7,8-double bond.
the reaction of vitamin D2 and D3 with sulfur dioxide was very rapid and that the reaction proceeded at the Δ5(6),10(19) double bond to give α- and β-adducts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
vitamin D2 is a more reactive diene than vitamin D3 and that the Δ5,6 double bond in the trans isomer is more reactive than that in the cis isomer.
vitamin D2 is much more reactive with sulfur dioxide than vitamin D3.
